import Mathlib

inductive Node where
  | nil
  | node (val : Nat) (left : Node) (right : Node)
deriving Inhabited, Repr

open Node

def view (t : Node) : Set Nat :=
  match t with
  | nil => ∅
  | node v l r => {v} ∪ view l ∪ view r

def tree_contains (t : Node) (target : Nat) : Bool :=
  match t with
  | nil => false
  | node v l r => v == target || tree_contains l target || tree_contains r target

def tree_distinct (t : Node) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | nil => True
  | node v l r =>
      tree_distinct l ∧ tree_distinct r ∧
      v ∉ view l ∧ v ∉ view r ∧
      (view l ∩ view r = ∅)

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def lowest_common_ancestor_precond (root : Node) (p q : Nat) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  tree_contains root p ∧ tree_contains root q ∧ tree_distinct root
  -- !benchmark @end precond

def aux (root : Node) (p q : Nat) : Option Nat × Bool × Bool :=
  match root with
  | nil => (none, false, false)
  | node val l r =>
      let (lcaL, hasPL, hasQL) := aux l p q
      let (lcaR, hasPR, hasQR) := aux r p q
      let hasP := (val == p) || hasPL || hasPR
      let hasQ := (val == q) || hasQL || hasQR
      let lca :=
        if lcaL.isSome then lcaL
        else if lcaR.isSome then lcaR
        else if hasP && hasQ then some val else none
      (lca, hasP, hasQ)

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def lca_impl (root : Node) (p q : Nat) : Option Nat :=
  match root with
  | nil => none
  | node v l r =>
      if tree_contains l p = true ∧ tree_contains l q = true then lca_impl l p q
      else if tree_contains r p = true ∧ tree_contains r q = true then lca_impl r p q
      else some v
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def lowest_common_ancestor (root : Node) (p q : Nat)
    (h_precond : lowest_common_ancestor_precond root p q) : Option Nat :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  lca_impl root p q
  -- !benchmark @end code

def is_ancestor (root : Node) (anc target : Nat) : Prop :=
  match root with
  | nil => False
  | node v l r =>
      if v = anc then tree_contains (node v l r) target = true
      else is_ancestor l anc target ∨ is_ancestor r anc target

-- ADDED: Helper to determine depth for the "Lowest" check
def get_depth (root : Node) (target : Nat) : Option Nat :=
  match root with
  | nil => none
  | node v l r =>
      if v == target then some 0
      else
        match get_depth l target, get_depth r target with
        | some d, _ => some (d + 1)
        | none, some d => some (d + 1)
        | none, none => none

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def lowest_common_ancestor_postcond (root : Node) (p q : Nat) (result : Option Nat)
    (_ : lowest_common_ancestor_precond root p q) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  match result with
  | some lca =>
      -- 1. Validity: It is a common ancestor
      is_ancestor root lca p ∧
      is_ancestor root lca q ∧
      -- 2. Optimality: It is the LOWEST (Deepest) common ancestor
      (∀ x, is_ancestor root x p → is_ancestor root x q →
         match get_depth root x, get_depth root lca with
         | some dx, some dres => dx ≤ dres
         | _, _ => True) -- Should imply dx and dres exist if is_ancestor is true
  | none => False
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
theorem set_disj {A B : Set Nat} (h : A ∩ B = ∅) {x : Nat} (h1 : x ∈ A) (h2 : x ∈ B) : False := by
  have hm : x ∈ A ∩ B := ⟨h1, h2⟩
  rw [h] at hm
  exact hm

theorem contains_view (t : Node) (x : Nat) : tree_contains t x = true ↔ x ∈ view t := by
  induction t with
  | nil => simp [tree_contains, view]
  | node v l r ihl ihr =>
      simp only [tree_contains, view, Bool.or_eq_true, beq_iff_eq, Set.mem_union,
        Set.mem_singleton_iff, ihl, ihr]
      tauto

theorem depth_isSome (t : Node) (x : Nat) : (get_depth t x).isSome = tree_contains t x := by
  induction t with
  | nil => rfl
  | node v l r ihl ihr =>
      by_cases h : v = x
      · simp [get_depth, tree_contains, h]
      · cases hl : get_depth l x <;> cases hr : get_depth r x <;>
          simp_all [get_depth, tree_contains]

theorem depth_some_of (t : Node) (x : Nat) (h : tree_contains t x = true) :
    ∃ d, get_depth t x = some d := by
  have hs := depth_isSome t x
  rw [h] at hs
  cases hd : get_depth t x with
  | none => rw [hd] at hs; simp at hs
  | some d => exact ⟨d, rfl⟩

theorem depth_none_of (t : Node) (x : Nat) (h : tree_contains t x = false) :
    get_depth t x = none := by
  have hs := depth_isSome t x
  rw [h] at hs
  cases hd : get_depth t x with
  | none => rfl
  | some d => rw [hd] at hs; simp at hs

theorem depth_node_self {v : Nat} {l r : Node} {x : Nat} (h : v = x) :
    get_depth (node v l r) x = some 0 := by
  simp [get_depth, h]

theorem depth_node_left {v : Nat} {l r : Node} {x d : Nat} (hne : ¬ (v = x))
    (h : get_depth l x = some d) : get_depth (node v l r) x = some (d + 1) := by
  simp [get_depth, hne, h]

theorem depth_node_right {v : Nat} {l r : Node} {x d : Nat} (hne : ¬ (v = x))
    (hl : get_depth l x = none) (h : get_depth r x = some d) :
    get_depth (node v l r) x = some (d + 1) := by
  simp [get_depth, hne, hl, h]

theorem anc_contains_anc (t : Node) (x tg : Nat) (h : is_ancestor t x tg) :
    tree_contains t x = true := by
  induction t with
  | nil => simp [is_ancestor] at h
  | node v l r ihl ihr =>
      simp only [is_ancestor] at h
      by_cases hv : v = x
      · simp [tree_contains, hv]
      · rw [if_neg hv] at h
        rcases h with h | h
        · simp [tree_contains, ihl h]
        · simp [tree_contains, ihr h]

theorem anc_contains_tg (t : Node) (x tg : Nat) (h : is_ancestor t x tg) :
    tree_contains t tg = true := by
  induction t with
  | nil => simp [is_ancestor] at h
  | node v l r ihl ihr =>
      simp only [is_ancestor] at h
      by_cases hv : v = x
      · rw [if_pos hv] at h; exact h
      · rw [if_neg hv] at h
        rcases h with h | h
        · simp [tree_contains, ihl h]
        · simp [tree_contains, ihr h]

theorem lca_main (t : Node) : ∀ p q : Nat, tree_distinct t → tree_contains t p = true →
    tree_contains t q = true →
    ∃ a, lca_impl t p q = some a ∧ is_ancestor t a p ∧ is_ancestor t a q ∧
      tree_contains t a = true ∧
      ∀ x, is_ancestor t x p → is_ancestor t x q → ∀ dx da,
        get_depth t x = some dx → get_depth t a = some da → dx ≤ da := by
  induction t with
  | nil => intro p q _ hp _; simp [tree_contains] at hp
  | node v l r ihl ihr =>
    intro p q hd hp hq
    simp only [tree_distinct] at hd
    obtain ⟨hdl, hdr, hvl, hvr, hlr⟩ := hd
    by_cases hA : tree_contains l p = true ∧ tree_contains l q = true
    · obtain ⟨a, ha, hap, haq, hain, hdeep⟩ := ihl p q hdl hA.1 hA.2
      have hav : ¬ (v = a) := by
        intro h
        exact hvl (by rw [h]; exact (contains_view l a).mp hain)
      have hrp : tree_contains r p = false := by
        cases hc : tree_contains r p
        · rfl
        · exact (set_disj hlr ((contains_view l p).mp hA.1) ((contains_view r p).mp hc)).elim
      have hrq : tree_contains r q = false := by
        cases hc : tree_contains r q
        · rfl
        · exact (set_disj hlr ((contains_view l q).mp hA.2) ((contains_view r q).mp hc)).elim
      refine ⟨a, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp only [lca_impl]; rw [if_pos hA]; exact ha
      · simp only [is_ancestor]; rw [if_neg hav]; exact Or.inl hap
      · simp only [is_ancestor]; rw [if_neg hav]; exact Or.inl haq
      · simp [tree_contains, hain]
      · intro x hxp hxq dx da hdx hda
        by_cases hxv : v = x
        · rw [depth_node_self hxv] at hdx
          injection hdx with e
          omega
        · simp only [is_ancestor] at hxp hxq
          rw [if_neg hxv] at hxp hxq
          have hxpl : is_ancestor l x p := by
            rcases hxp with h | h
            · exact h
            · rw [anc_contains_tg r x p h] at hrp; exact absurd hrp (by simp)
          have hxql : is_ancestor l x q := by
            rcases hxq with h | h
            · exact h
            · rw [anc_contains_tg r x q h] at hrq; exact absurd hrq (by simp)
          obtain ⟨dl, hdl'⟩ := depth_some_of l x (anc_contains_anc l x p hxpl)
          obtain ⟨dal, hdal⟩ := depth_some_of l a hain
          rw [depth_node_left hxv hdl'] at hdx
          rw [depth_node_left hav hdal] at hda
          injection hdx with e1
          injection hda with e2
          have := hdeep x hxpl hxql dl dal hdl' hdal
          omega
    · by_cases hB : tree_contains r p = true ∧ tree_contains r q = true
      · obtain ⟨a, ha, hap, haq, hain, hdeep⟩ := ihr p q hdr hB.1 hB.2
        have hav : ¬ (v = a) := by
          intro h
          exact hvr (by rw [h]; exact (contains_view r a).mp hain)
        have hlp : tree_contains l p = false := by
          cases hc : tree_contains l p
          · rfl
          · exact (set_disj hlr ((contains_view l p).mp hc) ((contains_view r p).mp hB.1)).elim
        have hlq : tree_contains l q = false := by
          cases hc : tree_contains l q
          · rfl
          · exact (set_disj hlr ((contains_view l q).mp hc) ((contains_view r q).mp hB.2)).elim
        have hla : tree_contains l a = false := by
          cases hc : tree_contains l a
          · rfl
          · exact (set_disj hlr ((contains_view l a).mp hc) ((contains_view r a).mp hain)).elim
        refine ⟨a, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simp only [lca_impl]; rw [if_neg hA, if_pos hB]; exact ha
        · simp only [is_ancestor]; rw [if_neg hav]; exact Or.inr hap
        · simp only [is_ancestor]; rw [if_neg hav]; exact Or.inr haq
        · simp [tree_contains, hain]
        · intro x hxp hxq dx da hdx hda
          by_cases hxv : v = x
          · rw [depth_node_self hxv] at hdx
            injection hdx with e
            omega
          · simp only [is_ancestor] at hxp hxq
            rw [if_neg hxv] at hxp hxq
            have hxpr : is_ancestor r x p := by
              rcases hxp with h | h
              · rw [anc_contains_tg l x p h] at hlp; exact absurd hlp (by simp)
              · exact h
            have hxqr : is_ancestor r x q := by
              rcases hxq with h | h
              · rw [anc_contains_tg l x q h] at hlq; exact absurd hlq (by simp)
              · exact h
            have hlx : tree_contains l x = false := by
              cases hc : tree_contains l x
              · rfl
              · exact (set_disj hlr ((contains_view l x).mp hc)
                  ((contains_view r x).mp (anc_contains_anc r x p hxpr))).elim
            obtain ⟨dr, hdr'⟩ := depth_some_of r x (anc_contains_anc r x p hxpr)
            obtain ⟨dar, hdar⟩ := depth_some_of r a hain
            rw [depth_node_right hxv (depth_none_of l x hlx) hdr'] at hdx
            rw [depth_node_right hav (depth_none_of l a hla) hdar] at hda
            injection hdx with e1
            injection hda with e2
            have := hdeep x hxpr hxqr dr dar hdr' hdar
            omega
      · refine ⟨v, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simp only [lca_impl]; rw [if_neg hA, if_neg hB]
        · simp only [is_ancestor, if_true]; exact hp
        · simp only [is_ancestor, if_true]; exact hq
        · simp [tree_contains]
        · intro x hxp hxq dx da hdx hda
          rw [depth_node_self (rfl : v = v)] at hda
          injection hda with e
          by_cases hxv : v = x
          · rw [depth_node_self hxv] at hdx
            injection hdx with e2
            omega
          · exfalso
            simp only [is_ancestor] at hxp hxq
            rw [if_neg hxv] at hxp hxq
            rcases hxp with h1 | h1 <;> rcases hxq with h2 | h2
            · exact hA ⟨anc_contains_tg l x p h1, anc_contains_tg l x q h2⟩
            · exact set_disj hlr ((contains_view l x).mp (anc_contains_anc l x p h1))
                ((contains_view r x).mp (anc_contains_anc r x q h2))
            · exact set_disj hlr ((contains_view l x).mp (anc_contains_anc l x q h2))
                ((contains_view r x).mp (anc_contains_anc r x p h1))
            · exact hB ⟨anc_contains_tg r x p h1, anc_contains_tg r x q h2⟩
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem lowest_common_ancestor_postcond_satisfied (root : Node) (p q : Nat)
    (h_precond : lowest_common_ancestor_precond root p q) :
    lowest_common_ancestor_postcond root p q (lowest_common_ancestor root p q h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  obtain ⟨hp, hq, hdist⟩ := h_precond
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hap, haq, hain, hdeep⟩ := lca_main root p q hdist hp hq
  have hres : lowest_common_ancestor root p q ⟨hp, hq, hdist⟩ = some a := ha
  simp only [lowest_common_ancestor_postcond, hres]
  refine ⟨hap, haq, ?_⟩
  intro x h1 h2
  cases hdx : get_depth root x with
  | none => simp
  | some dx =>
    cases hda : get_depth root a with
    | none => simp
    | some da => exact hdeep x h1 h2 dx da hdx hda
  -- !benchmark @end proof

## What I did (in `Solution.lean`, marker regions only)

**auxcode** — `lca_impl`, a structurally recursive LCA that's much easier to reason about than the given `aux`:

```lean
| node v l r =>
    if l contains both p,q then lca_impl l p q
    else if r contains both p,q then lca_impl r p q
    else some v
```

**code** — `lca_impl root p q`.

**lemma** — bridge lemmas plus one strengthened induction:

- `contains_view` : `tree_contains t x = true ↔ x ∈ view t` — connects the Bool-level algorithm to the `Set`-level `tree_distinct`.
- `depth_isSome` : `(get_depth t x).isSome = tree_contains t x`, with `depth_some_of` / `depth_none_of` corollaries.
- `depth_node_self/left/right` : compute a node's depth from its children's.
- `anc_contains_anc`, `anc_contains_tg` : `is_ancestor t x tg` implies `t` contains both `x` and `tg`.
- `lca_main` : by induction on the tree, produces `a` with `lca_impl t p q = some a`, both ancestor facts, `tree_contains t a`, **and** the depth bound for every common ancestor.

The optimality argument turns on disjointness (`view l ∩ view r = ∅`): in the left case a common ancestor `x ≠ v` can't sit in `r` (that would make `r` contain `p`), so the IH's bound lifts through `+1`; in the right case disjointness also forces `get_depth l x = none`, giving depth `dr + 1`; in the terminal case any `x ≠ v` would have to live in both subtrees or contradict the case conditions, so `x = v` and `dx = 0`.

**proof** — instantiates `lca_main`, rewrites the result to `some a`, then discharges the postcondition's `match` on the two depth options (the `none` branches are `True`).

No `sorry`, `axiom`, `partial`, or other escapes; nothing outside the four marker regions was touched, and no other file was created or modified.
